note: dev and replicate-noise seeds only; no fresh seed is read here

sense.edit: darkFleeGenome as is (emits in the dark, moves down the signal gradient)

sense-nosig.edit: darkFleeGenome with EMIT bias and the EMIT weight from hidden unit 1 zeroed; movement wiring kept (information-free, movement-capable)

sense-nomot.edit: darkFleeGenome with motility gain 0 (emits, does not move)

drift.edit: sunFollowerGenome (blind east drifter, MX bias 32, gain 12)

sensitivity.rule: sensitive = senseTracks and floorUsable. senseTracks: twice the median of (still - sense) absolute circular tracking error over dev blocks and placements must exceed twice the largest replicate-noise spread of the still arm's error. floorUsable: the fixed-schedule capture floor delta_cap must not exceed maxFloorCapPpm

crossTalk.method: foreign signal = (signal in a radius-3 disc at body 0 with all bodies) - (signal at the same cells with body 0 alone), at the horizon, fixed schedule, dev seed 1; the signal field has no ownership so this is measured once on the frozen geometry, not per run

ladder.note: workload fits the budget at bench; no reduction step was applied

workload.formula: fresh seeds * schedules * strategies * 2 placements + fixture seeds * 3 strategies * 2 placements, each T steps
